newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA BUCHAREST V ATLETICO MADRID TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA BUCHAREST V ATLETICO MADRID TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup Champions' League group B match between Steaua Bucharest of Romania and Atletico Madrid of Spain:

Steaua Bucharest: 23-Bogdan Stelea, 3-Roland Nagy, 5-Bucur Bogdan, 6-Daniel Prodan, 7-Marius Lacatus, 8-Damian Militaru, 11-Sabin Ilie, 9 Augustin Calin, 15-Marius Baciu, 16-Iulian Miu, 22-Denis Serban.

Atletico Madrid: 1-Jose Francisco Molina, 2-Pablo Alfaro, 4-Roberto Solozabal, 5-Juan Manuel Lopez, 9-Juan Eduardo Esnaider, 10-Milinko Pantic, 14-Diego Pablo Simeone, 19-Francisco Narvaez, 20-Delfin Geli, 21-Jose Luis Perez Caminero, 24-Radek Bejbl.
